concepts.name: A Wary Relic-Hunter
concepts.brief: Digs old ruins for pay and trusts nothing found inside them.

concepts.name: A Broken Inquisitor
concepts.brief: Once hunted heresies for a faith that no longer answers.

concepts.name: A Runaway Cartographer
concepts.brief: Fled a survey that found something no map should show.

concepts.name: A Hedge Surgeon
concepts.brief: Patches wounds and worse for coin, no questions asked.

concepts.name: A Disgraced Duellist
concepts.brief: Lost the duel that mattered, and lives with who saw it.

skills.name: Reads Old Stonework
skills.brief: Makes sense of inscriptions and stonework that everyone else reads as rubble.

skills.name: Quiet Hands
skills.brief: Picks locks, pockets, and latches without a sound.

skills.name: Steady Under Fire
skills.brief: Keeps a clear head once things turn violent.

skills.name: Talks Their Way In
skills.brief: Talks past guards, clerks, and doors that should stay shut.

skills.name: Knows the Old Rites
skills.brief: Recognizes an old rite or ritual for what it actually is.

skills.name: Never Loses the Trail
skills.brief: Follows a trail across ground that hides it from anyone else.

frailties.name: Never Walks Away
frailties.brief: Cannot leave a fight, or a wrong, unfinished.

frailties.name: Owes a Bad Debt
frailties.brief: Owes someone dangerous, and they will collect.

frailties.name: Cannot Leave a Question Alone
frailties.brief: Cannot let a loose thread go unpulled, whatever it costs.

frailties.name: Known to the Wrong People
frailties.brief: Recognized by people who are best left as strangers.

frailties.name: Flinches at the Dark
frailties.brief: Freezes when the light goes and the dark closes in.

gear.name: Pry Bar
gear.brief: Forces a door, a crate, or a stubborn slab of stone.

gear.name: Chalk and Wire
gear.brief: Marks a trail and rigs a lock from chalk and a length of wire.

gear.name: Guttering Lantern
gear.brief: Throws light into places that would rather stay dark.

gear.name: Worn Duelling Blade
gear.brief: A blade worn smooth from a life spent drawing it.

gear.name: Physician's Roll
gear.brief: Splints, stitches, and staves off the worst of a wound.

gear.name: Forged Seal and Ink
gear.brief: Forges a seal and passes as someone with the right to be there.
